review_findings: Same-directory temporary write plus hard-link publication is atomic and non-overwriting across processes on the supported local filesystem.
FileExistsError preserves first-writer ownership and still permits idempotent equivalent retries.
The patch is limited to storage integrity and does not alter Host, Workflow, TaskRun or write authority semantics.
